page.overview:
Who is Herald of the Change?

The Herald of the Change was an official appointed by the Padishah Emperor Shaddam Corrino IV to oversee the appointment of House Atreides as the steward of Arrakis.

The Herald was sent to Caladan by the Padishah Emperor Shaddam Corrino IV alongside members of the Imperial Court, representatives of the Spacing Guild and a sister of the Bene Gesserit to offer the stewardship of Arrakis to House Atreides. Upon their arrival, the Herald read the decree aloud to Duke Leto Atreides and asked him if he accepted its terms, to which the Duke agreed. He then reminded Leto to place his seal upon the decree with his ducal ring. Once he has done so, he asked the Herald if this has concluded their business and the herald confirms that it had.
